claims.sentence: The study objectives are: * To assess the ex vivo effects of Omacor® on platelet function in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD). * To compare ex vivo platelet-related effects after 7 and 14 days of therapy with Omacor and statin combination versus statin alone in patients with chronic stable coronary heart disease. * To establish the relation of changes in platelet activity (if any) with the lipid profile to prove an additional benefit of Omacor® on top of statin and aspirin.
